nodes.title: SG-8.3.3 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
context.md still says README-only/'hello Worldseed' with UNKNOWN placeholders. Rewrite it so it names the real stack and modules and the 9 failing context unit tests pass.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the rewritten context.md When contextDoc.test.ts runs Then all 6 stack-terms/stale-text tests pass
- Given the rewritten context.md When contextPaths.test.ts runs Then all 3 module-path tests pass


## Scope
- In scope: SG-8.3.3 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
- Out of scope: Any change to game/src, game/frontend/src or backend/
- Out of scope: Rewriting the GDD (game/docs/GDD.md)
- Preserve: docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts exports and STACK_TERMS/STALE_TEXT contracts
- Preserve: Existing context tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 (no Phaser 4 migration); the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- Every step lands green: npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped
- `backend/` (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope; no source change under game/src or game/frontend/src


## Definition of done
- context.md has no UNKNOWN placeholder and no README-only text
- Both context suites pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
